C0613.title: Why Loaning Funds Obtained Through Credit Card Cash Advances Is Not a Private Lending Arrangement
C0613.summary: The Supreme People's Procuratorate disclosed a case where Rui Mou used a POS machine provided by Cui Mou to obtain cash through a credit card cash advance and then lent 23,000 yuan to Cui Mou. This act was determined to be the re-lending of funds obtained by cashing out a financial institution loan and does not constitute a lawful private lending relationship.

references.title: Why Lending Credit Card Funds Isn't Private Lending - Supreme People's Procuratorate of the People's Republic of China
